hero.title: Automate Clinical Records & Patient Flow with USADA AI
hero.subtitle: The USADA AI platform is engineered by Usada Tech: transcribing doctor consultations into instant SOAP notes and managing WhatsApp patient reservations directly into local SIMRS. Save 2 hours of doctor documentation daily, streamline clinic queues, and secure patient data locally on-premise.

card1.title: Administrative Burden
card1.desc: Clinic doctors allocate a significant portion of consultation time to drafting medical records (SOAP/CPPT). Meanwhile, administrative staff face manual validation burdens on clinical documentation.

card2.title: Significant Impacts & Risks
card2.desc: Clerical errors can lead to delays in patient care and clinical record backlog. Excessive workload causes chronic burnout among medical staff, impacting the standard of patient care.

solution.title: 5 Core Clinical Modules in the USADA AI Platform
solution.subtitle: Engineered by Usada Tech to reduce physician documentation time, accelerate BPJS claim validation, and secure patient data on local servers:

service1.title: 1. AI Rekam Medis
service1.desc: Automated SOAP (CPPT) medical notes from doctor-patient conversations, complete with ICD-10 diagnostic and ICD-9-CM procedure coding.

service2.title: 2. AI Chatbot & WhatsApp Reminder
service2.desc: 24/7 outpatient WhatsApp registration, initial symptom triage, and automated follow-up visit reminders so patients never miss their appointments.

service3.title: 3. AI BPJS
service3.desc: Pre-validation of BPJS Kesehatan and casemix claim files prior to submission, preventing pending or disputed claims for faster reimbursement.

service4.title: 4. AI Finance Health
service4.desc: Reconciliation of INA-CBGs package rates against actual clinic costs, tracking medical procedure margins and operational expenses transparently.

service5.title: 5. AI for Healthcare Research (For Doctors)
service5.desc: Clinical research assistant for doctors to search PubMed literature, compare patient case studies, and reference up-to-date scientific evidence.
